production.note: US model years 2023 to present. Cadillac (11 May 2022): 'The 2023 Escalade-V goes on sale late this summer'. Still on sale: Cadillac's current Escalade-V page is for the 2027 model with '682 HORSEPOWER' (cadillac-escalade-v-2027-page).

body.note: Offered in standard and long-wheelbase ESV lengths (Cadillac's table has ESCALADE-V and ESCALADE-V ESV columns); the standard length is the standard car.

powerHp.note: Cadillac 2023 Escalade-V specifications (North America), ENGINES. Quote: "Horsepower (hp / kW @ rpm): 682 / 508 @ 6,000"; "Torque (lb-ft / Nm): 653 / 885 @ 4,400". The release text called it an estimate at the time: "Rated at a GM-estimated 682 horsepower at 6,000 engine rpm and 653 lb-ft of torque at 4,400 engine rpm". Cadillac's current 2027 Escalade-V page still states '682 HORSEPOWER' (cadillac-escalade-v-2027-page), confirming 682 hp as the standing rating.

weightLb.note: Cadillac 2023 Escalade-V specifications, CAPACITIES AND TRAILERING, standard-length Escalade-V. Quote: "Curb Weight (lb. / kg): 6217 / 2820" (Escalade-V ESV: 6407 / 2906). Not labelled estimate.
